quotes.text: A record keeper CRM tells you what already happened. A sales HQ tells you what deserves your attention right now and with which tactic
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sharp contrast between passive CRM and guided selling.

quotes.text: The CRM stops being that separate place you dread updating tracking an email or logging a meeting becomes a natural extension of writing the message or joining the call
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why Outlook and Teams integration drives CRM adoption.

quotes.text: Copilot doesn't steal the dice from your hand. It doesn't decide which deal you chase. It sorts scores and recommends, leaving priority and execution up to you.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies the human-in-control role of Copilot in sales.

quotes.text: Spreadsheets tell you where things were supposed to be when someone last updated them. Predictive forecasting in d three sixty five shows you where they actually are right now.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable case for predictive over spreadsheet forecasting.

quotes.text: Numbers alone can flag a deal slipping in probability, but they don't explain the story. Relationship analytics fills in the why.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows how relationship signals add context to forecasts.

Copilot as your pipeline's dungeon master

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Sales shifts CRM from passive record keeping to guided selling with playbooks, sequences and next best actions.
Outlook and Teams integration plus Copilot summaries and drafts keep sellers in context and cut manual logging.
Predictive forecasting, relationship analytics and LinkedIn Sales Navigator signals reveal deal risks early enough to act.
hook: Many sales teams still treat their CRM as a digital address book and lose hours to manual logging. This episode shows sellers and sales managers how Dynamics 365 Sales with Copilot, Outlook and Teams integration, predictive forecasting and LinkedIn signals turns the CRM into a real command hub.
